current_activity: halted on Hill 67 on the east bank while trying to cross upstream
notes: Miller, ch. V, and Zimmerman, ch. VI, agree that on 27 September the 1st Raider Battalion moved upstream to cross about 2,000 yards from the mouth, was halted by unexpected fire on Hill 67 on the east bank (a Japanese force had crossed in the night), and that Griffith was wounded and Bailey killed. No separate Hill 67 place is added. Confidence 0.7.

current_activity: beating back a Japanese breakout on the east bank at dusk
notes: Miller, ch. V: at 1800 on 8 October Japanese climbed out of their foxholes and struck the raiders’ right flank in a hand-to-hand fight, some survivors being killed against the wire on the sand bar. Zimmerman, ch. VI, has raider companies ordered forward on 7–8 October to relieve the 5th Marines at the bridgehead. Confidence 0.7.
